title: Query audit reliability and safer ticker grounding
points: Unknown uppercase ticker-like requests now close as out-of-universe instead of retrieving nearest valid tickers, so a query such as BFARGO no longer pulls BFAGRO evidence.
Finance acronyms such as COGS, NPAT, and GM are treated as business concepts in trace audits instead of false unresolved ticker symbols.
Gemini router and lane calls use the pinned Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite model with shared retry handling for rate limits and transient 5xx failures.
Admin issue traces now expose error classes and distinguish cancelled runs from hard failures, making daily failure triage faster and less dependent on manual D1 joins.
